steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Versicle and response
steps.versicle: Pray for us, O blessed St. Joseph:
steps.response: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Offer your novena intention through the hands of St. Joseph.

prayer_to_st_joseph.text:
O St. Joseph, whose protection is so great, so strong, so prompt before the throne of God,
I place in you all my interests and desires.
O St. Joseph, do assist me by your powerful intercession
and obtain for me from your divine Son
all spiritual blessings through Jesus Christ, our Lord;
so that having engaged here below your heavenly power,
I may offer my thanksgiving and homage to the most loving of fathers.
O St. Joseph, I never weary of contemplating you and Jesus asleep in your arms;
I dare not approach while He reposes near your heart.
Press Him in my name and kiss His fine head for me,
and ask Him to return the kiss when I draw my dying breath.
St. Joseph, patron of departing souls, pray for us.
Amen.
prayer_to_st_joseph.latin: O Sancte Ioseph, cuius protectio tam magna, tam fortis, tam prompta est ante thronum Dei, commendo tibi omnia mea studia atque desideria. O Sancte Ioseph, adiuva me tua potenti intercessione, et impetra mihi a divino Filio tuo omnes benedictiones spirituales per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum, ut cum caelesti virtute tua hic in terris usus fuerim, gratiarum actionem et obsequium offerre possim amantissimo Patri. O Sancte Ioseph, nunquam fatigor te contemplari et Iesum dormientem in brachiis tuis; non audeo accedere dum Ipse requiescit iuxta cor tuum. Preme Eum meo nomine et osculare pulchrum caput eius pro me, et roga Eum ut osculum reddat cum spiritum efflavero. Sancte Ioseph, patrōne morientium, ora pro nobis. Amen.

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

sjo_closing.text: St. Joseph, chaste spouse of Mary and guardian of the Child Jesus: keep me under thy protection as thou didst keep them, and bring my nine days to the joy of thy solemnity. Obtain for me, through thy intercession, the grace I ask in this novena, if it be for the greater glory of God and the good of my soul. Amen.

schedule_note.note: The traditional nine days before the Solemnity of St. Joseph: March 10 through 18, completing on the feast (March 19, not due). The session is a single static session; the pack embeds the committed companion import's prayer attributed to Pope Pius X in preference to the modern copyrighted novena booklets.
